name: First Battle of Ypres
notes: British official dates 19 October to 22 November. The German account closes on 17 November; the French and German official histories use other dates again (YC01). Not in CDB90 or the War Atlas dataset.

name: Battle of Langemarck
notes: British official name and dates (21 to 24 October). Edmonds starts his chapter on the 22nd.

name: Battle of Gheluvelt
notes: Usually 29 to 31 October; Edmonds carries the name to 5 November (YC08).

name: Battle of Nonne Bosschen
notes: One day. Rows for the days after it that follow from the attack are filed here too.

name: Battle of Messines (1914)
notes: A separate battle in the British list, fought at the same time on the right of Ypres (S45).

name: Battle of the Yser
notes: Belgian and French battle on the left of Ypres. Dates as given in S44; the German official history runs it to 30 November.
